headline: Get Pomegg
title: How to Get Pomegg | Rosetower Woods Fork | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Want a Pomegg in Aniimo? The basic form lives in Rosetower Woods, at levels forty three to fifty. Raise it to level twenty five and it forks. Spend a Sprout Stone for Pomawk, or complete the Discovery event quests and use a Roar Stone for Dazmand. Each Pomegg takes only one branch, so choose carefully. Pomawk or Dazmand? Comment below!
description: Pomegg spawns in Rosetower Woods (levels 43-50) and evolves at level 25 into Pomawk (Sprout Stone) or Dazmand (Roar Stone plus Aniimo Discovery event quests).
